L4-0445.note: N row; the person first, since that is how 会计 is used of someone's job.

L4-0488.note: N row. Second gloss says what kind of snack, since 快餐 holds 'snack' loosely at L2.

L4-0489.note: V row. Bare 'to spread' is 传播 at L3; 流传 is passing down through time.

L4-0499.note: N row. Bare 'paper' would answer to 纸; 'treatise' is register-heavy.

L4-0516.note: Adj/V row. Bare 'close' is already spoken for by 亲密 and 紧密 at this level.

L4-0517.note: No official POS. 'free' alone would read as free-as-in-liberty.

L4-0518.note: V row. 面对 L3 holds 'to face'; 面临 is being confronted by a situation.

L4-0525.note: V row. Bare 'to touch' is 着 zháo at the same level; CEDICT's 'to steal' sense is excluded.

L4-0528.note: N row. The powder and opera-role senses are out of level.

L4-0529.note: Adv row, so an adverb has to lead; 'in silence' reads as a noun phrase.

L4-0558.note: N row. Split from 质量 at the same level, which takes plain 'quality'.

L4-0566.note: V row, so the noun 'expectation' cannot lead.

L4-0574.note: N row. 'soda pop' is regional; the leading gloss describes the drink.

L4-0576.note: N row. Unqualified 'organ' reads as the instrument; the physiology label is not learner copy.
